title: crontick media card data file
description: Data file (data.json) for a media card: the data key is bound to the media payload. Not expressible in JSON Schema, enforced by the validator: data must be an object unless error is a non-empty string; error "" is treated as null (default null); updatedAt must be an RFC 3339 timestamp with offset or Z. When error is set the payload is not validated. The generic data.json leaves the payload open; the validator applies the per-type payload schema chosen by the card type.

data.title: crontick media card data
data.description: Not expressible in JSON Schema, enforced by the validator: src must be an http(s) URL or a data:image/* URI; link values must be http, https, mailto or ms-outlook.
